svg.title: Tangent has vertical asymptotes
svg.desc: The tangent branches are not joined across the dashed vertical asymptotes at negative pi over two and positive pi over two. Zeros at negative pi, zero and pi are marked; the two central quarter-turn anchor points have heights negative one and one.
